label: PF Backlog 656
title: Review tooling hardening: derived-doc content, material approval ordering, coverage edge cases

brief.problem: Residual review-tooling edge cases found after 1485/1484.
brief.what_adds: Derived-doc content checks, material-approval ordering, coverage tests.
brief.why_now: Keep the gate trustworthy without blocking 1484 finalization.
brief.success: Tooling edge cases closed with tests.

objective: Harden review tooling after BI-PF-1484 post-merge findings: derived-doc content validation, per-breach material approval migration, and review-coverage ancestry tests.
acceptance_criteria: Derived docs (BACKLOG-SUMMARY, documentation-index) are validated against generator output/content and cannot carry arbitrary executable content.
MATERIAL_CHANGE approvals require an at timestamp after the reviews they excuse, with a migration/back-compat rule; negative test covers older approval.
architect_review_check coverage proves reviewed_head is an ancestor and that no review-relevant changes occurred; tests cover stale/older evidence.
One 2.5 on the hardening candidate; precheck passes.
in_scope: Review tooling hardening: derived-doc content, material approval ordering, coverage edge cases
approach: Review tooling hardening: derived-doc content, material approval ordering, coverage edge cases

divergences: 1485 treated derived docs as path-excluded; 1486 requires content/generator validation.

impact_review.evidence: Extends review tools; no new store.

verification: Objective achieved: Review tooling hardening: derived-doc content, material approval ordering, coverage edge cases

analysis.implementation_strategy: EXTEND core/context_review.py and core/cross_review.py to validate derived-doc (index/journal) content integrity; enforce material-approval ordering via config/approval-policy.json + /api/v1/engineering/pidl/approvals flow; harden coverage edge cases in knowledge_registry/knowledge_compiler and the coverage endpoints. Reuse agent_ledger/call_ledger for audit emission. No new components; edits are to shipped Python (allowed) plus config/tests.
dependency_findings: RELATED BI-PF-1485 (review tooling deltas/gates) — align scope boundaries
REQUIRES BI-0179 derived index/journal layout stable (content validation targets it)
RELATED BI-PF-0377 PIDL decision engine — approval ordering interacts with APPROVAL_REQUIRED path
conflict_findings: Concurrent edits possible on context_review.py if BI-PF-1485 lands same cycle — serialize or branch-guard
config/approval-policy.json shared with PIDL approvals — coordinate changes
No other open item touches knowledge_compiler coverage logic
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1485 already covers delta re-reviews/gates — keep 1486 scoped to content/ordering/coverage hardening to avoid overlap
No existing backlog item owns derived-doc content validation or approval ordering
Coverage endpoints exist; extend rather than add parallel coverage checks
analysis.rationale: Hardening extends existing review/coverage modules and configs; reuse-first MODIFY with low drift. Blocked only on pinning 'material approval' semantics and known coverage edge cases.
assumptions: BI-0179 per-item + derived index/journal schema is settled
Existing coverage endpoints are the single source for coverage truth
Approval ordering is a validation concern, not a scheduler concern
risks: Approval-ordering change could deadlock PIDL flows if ordering rules too strict
Derived-doc content checks may false-positive on legacy items pre-BI-0179
Coverage edge-case fixes may alter existing coverage metrics (baseline drift in config/architect-review-baseline.json)
evidence: Configs pf-review-scope.json, approval-policy.json, review-budget.json already pin review behaviour
